title: LLM意见多样性：什么真正重要？
summary: 通过析因实验研究LLM输出多样性，发现：人物角色细节并非越多越好；不同交互架构探索不同意见区域，组合使用优于单一优化；常见低成本方法（如提高采样温度）效果甚微。
summary_en: A factorial experiment on LLM opinion diversity reveals that more persona detail does not monotonically increase diversity, different interaction architectures explore non-overlapping opinion regions, and low-cost alternatives like raising temperature have negligible effects.
